reasons.overall_mobile: Strong atmosphere and substantial touch assistance support playable navigation and combat, but orientation, cover and contextual hold friction repeatedly disrupted control. Two losses alone do not determine this score.
reasons.controls: Tap aim, route assist, recovery assist and simultaneous stick/fire worked; fine orientation and repositioning around close cover were difficult. Context transitions were easy to mishandle.
reasons.gameplay: Observed recovery-to-Custodian progression and exposed-coil timing created understandable objectives and tactical choices. Off-screen pressure made recovery and repositioning punishing; final upload and later content unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Distinctive teal/amber palette, rain, architecture, weapon and terminal/menu typography produced a coherent atmosphere in the viewed frames. Audio and motion smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: Helpful handbook, paused planning map and clear fresh/retry choices. Route/recovery context required more attention than expected and long holds could leave the player stationary under attack.
reasons.readability: Large health/ammo and objective markers were legible. Small compass/threat/coil status text and transient overlays were harder to parse on the narrow viewport.
